value.title: Create your life – Without limits
value.main_text_excerpt:
Life Coaching is about co-creating a powerful partnership to serve you, and work towards living the life you truly want. It can really be anything!
Have a look to learn more, and to see if coaching might be for you
Want to implement a healthier lifestyle? Together we can create the perfect plan for you!
With the unique combination of life-coaching and personal training, we make sure that your exercise is not only effective, but purposeful, sustaining, satisfying and in line with what you really want
You are Already Perfect
You are already where you are supposed to be and you already have the power to be who you want to be
Coaching is about working with who you are and what you have, in order to move forward. Anything is possible. My role is to provide encouragement, support, accountability and perspective, and to assist you in moving forward in the direction of your choosing
I am not here to judge - my only question is: What do you want?
Interested?
It's natural to have a lot of questions!
Click the button below to schedule a commitment-free and free of charge conversation with me, where we find out if coaching is for you and what it might look like

pages.title: About Me
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Certification
Graduated from Universitetet i Agder (The University of Agder) as a Personal Trainer in 2017.
Graduated from Institute of Professional Excellence in Coaching (iPEC) as an ICF accredited coach in 2019.
My story
At the end of a relationship, when I was 20, i was at the lowest point in my life.
I was miserable, lost and didnt even know who I was. When I randomly came over the phrase “You cannot love someone, before you love yourself” on the internet, it really hit hard and it hit home. It was true!
“But, how do I even go about loving myself? Is it even something I can do?” I asked. It was something I had never thought of before.
I remember looking up videos like “How to love yourself” and “How to be more confident” on Youtube, namely by Leo Gura, who was the biggest influence in the beginning of my search.
I applied some off the things that were said to situations in my life. As I did, my perception changed and my behavior changed, and I experienced confidence and freedom.
Huh… So by applying self-help tools and new ways of thinking in my life, my experience and way of being changed. It seemed that who I was and how i felt wasn’t so rigid and set in stone. What more is possible? Nothing seemed more significant to me. Am I truly free to be who I want to be?
I started from scratch.. and realized over time that we have immense power and ability to control various aspects of our life. As well as consciously making different choices throughout our day, we may also change the very foundation in which our decitions are made, our needs. 
Even our very experience of the world itself! You can change the meaning of the things around you, which you never questioned because they seemed obvious. You can change the way you see the world, not only at large, but the very things around you. 
And because you see things differently, your experience of the world changes naturally!
This is what ultimately led me to coaching and to fitness and health. I wanted to work with people and in the field of personal development.
Through the transformative experiences I have had and things that I have learned, the potential value and growth is clear as day.
I am far off from being perfect, believe me. But its not about being perfect, its about being open and honest and about taking responsibility to be the best that you are able to be today, in the belief of a better tomorrow.
Uncover your potential
Check out the information about coaching and fitness and health, or click here to schedule a commitment free and free of charge appointment, to uncover what coaching might look like for you!
